title: Strengthen Social Protection for All Workers
discussion_signal: The post shares the ILO policy discussion on protecting workers across changing forms of employment and connects universal social protection with worker organization, changing labour markets, and just-transition policy.
linked_research_question: How should social-protection systems adapt coverage, financing, and worker voice as employment becomes more varied and insecure?
limits: The post points to policy research but does not provide comparative outcome data
It is an institutional policy discussion rather than a worker survey
It does not resolve financing or implementation trade-offs
